source.location: latitude/longitude: the home-region spawn point, racing_game data/world/world_config.json lines 18-22 (50.14988 N, 8.45474 E) as cited by out/weather_plan.md section 2.3; elevation 150 m is ASSUMED (from W4 on it is the weather station elevation the atmosphere is lifted from).
source.seasons: doy_span: the meteorological seasons of the northern hemisphere (spring 1 March - 31 May = day of year 60-151, summer 1 June - 31 August = 152-243, autumn 1 September - 30 November = 244-334, winter 1 December - 28 February = 335-59, non-leap year) - a DEFINITION, not a measurement. days: 31 per season is ASSUMED (an odd count puts the season midpoint on a day centre; the game year is 124 days). No temperature/humidity/pressure scalars are given: none is invented here, the statistics for temperate_de_home.json come from DWD climate normals in a later increment.
source.purpose: test fixture: with the calendar fixed to season "summer" every day carries the summer mid-season values (tests/unit/test_environment_calendar.cpp, E2).
